auth_description: Park Smarter consumer mobile API at apiv3.parksmarter.com uses bearer tokens from POST /api/Auth/LoginWithPhoneAndPassword (or import via auth login --token-file). Not IPS partner DMS APIs.
description: Agent-native CLI for Park Smarter (IPS Group) consumer accounts: zone/meter lookup, sessions, and hard-gated start/extend/stop.

novel_features.name: Hard-gated live parking
novel_features.description: Charges only with --enable-live-parking --owner-approved --confirm "START PARK SMARTER PARKING"; parking preview never mutates.

novel_features.name: Bearer token auth
novel_features.description: Phone/password or token import; secrets stored mode 0600 under ~/.config/parksmarter-pp-cli/, never printed.

novel_features.name: APK-verified consumer host
novel_features.description: Targets apiv3.parksmarter.com discovered from com.ipsgroupinc.parksmarter v4.4.0, not marketing site or DMS APIs.
